title: TBM 930 Operator Path (4 Weeks)
description: A structured TBM 930 progression from startup and power management to weather-aware IFR operations and precision landing control.

lessons.title: Cold & Dark to Taxi
lessons.objective: Build a reliable startup and pre-taxi flow in the TBM 930 with correct cockpit preparation.

lessons.title: Takeoff + Climb Energy Management
lessons.objective: Control torque, climb profile, and automation usage to keep the aircraft stable and efficient.

lessons.title: Weather Radar + VNAV Control
lessons.objective: Use radar tilt/gain and VNAV planning to stay ahead of weather and descent constraints.

lessons.title: Approach + Short-Field Precision
lessons.objective: Refine approach speed control, touchdown timing, and rollout braking for consistent landings.
